assumptions: Without the change, the series continues as the model of the period before it predicts
The change did not touch the control series
avoid_when: The change also changed the control series
Other events occurred at the same time as the change
You have fewer than about 10 periods before the change

data_needs: One number over time at a regular frequency, before and after the change

about.example: A TV campaign from 1 March added 4,200 sales in 8 weeks (range 2,900 to 5,500).
about.expert_notes: CausalImpact (Brodersen et al. 2015) on the ts.bsts core: a Bayesian structural time series with the controls as static regressors is fitted on the pre-period only. The counterfactual is the one-step-ahead prediction in the pre-period and a predictive forecast from the terminal state after the start (common random numbers). The effect is actual minus counterfactual, per draw; the cumulative effect sums the post cells. Interrupted time series is the case without controls.
outputs: Actual values and the values without the change, with a range
The effect in each period and the total effect
The probability that the effect is more than zero
A chart of the fit before the change

references.title: Brodersen et al. (2015), Inferring causal impact using Bayesian structural time-series models, Annals of Applied Statistics

about.summary_plain: Measures the effect of a campaign, a launch or a change on one series. It compares the actual values with the values that the model predicts without the change.
about.title: Effect of a campaign on one series
use_when: A campaign, a launch or a price change started on a known date
You have other series that the change did not touch (for example the sales in other countries, or searches for the category)
You want the effect with a range, for each period and in total

manifest.description: CausalImpact / interrupted time series: a Bayesian structural time series fitted on the periods before an intervention, with control series as regressors, predicts the series without the intervention; the effect is actual minus that counterfactual.

effect.description: The effect of the intervention: y minus what y would be without it
